findings.title: manifest and cleanup retain stale validation receipt hash after R4 update
findings.observation: Actual validation_receipt.json SHA-256 is cf2254b4959406f94908fd0c9fce99270ce9c416023093b1b6a103263f901980, while both manifest and cleanup record 570577dbc2aa023c3a3d5153d7ee52f0635853c80e8900c2b39f357a0b8d056e. The R4 exact path set is closed at 51, but the hash ledger is not.
findings.required_action: Update only the authorized W1 implementer ledger fields, refresh dependent hashes without circular self-hashing, and independently recompute all 51 rows. Preserve the two distinct R4 raw files and all PID34140 evidence.
